interpretation: Each mutant must produce exactly the declared failed-check set. Multi-check effects are permitted only where one defect necessarily changes multiple independently specified public artifacts.

appointment_create_and_filters.rationale: Filtering/persistence projection defect is confined to the projection check.

appointment_interval_validation.rationale: Invalid interval acceptance is isolated from other appointment behavior.

appointment_provider_conflicts.rationale: Boundary-overlap defect is isolated to provider conflict semantics.

appointment_reschedule_atomic.rationale: Pre-validation mutation is isolated to atomic rescheduling.

appointment_cancel_releases_slot.rationale: Cancellation state/capacity defect is isolated to terminal release semantics.

shipment_create_and_filters.rationale: Filtering/persistence projection defect is confined to the projection check.

shipment_valid_transition_path.rationale: The projected-state defect is isolated to the complete transition path.

shipment_skipped_transition_atomic.rationale: Skipped-transition acceptance is isolated to exact-next transition atomicity.

shipment_event_idempotency.rationale: Replay mutation is isolated to event identity semantics.

shipment_time_and_terminal_invariants.rationale: Stale/terminal event acceptance is isolated to temporal and terminal invariants.

jsonl_grouped_counts.rationale: Aggregate total corruption leaves timezone placement and summary conservation unchanged.

jsonl_utc_date_normalization.rationale: Local-date grouping necessarily changes both the UTC sentinel placement and the emitted groups.

jsonl_invalid_and_duplicate_handling.rationale: Accepting a duplicate necessarily changes rejection evidence, aggregates, and conservation totals.

jsonl_summary_consistency.rationale: Summary corruption is isolated from detailed artifacts.

jsonl_deterministic_outputs.rationale: Seed-dependent extra metadata leaves business content intact but breaks byte determinism.

reconciliation_rows_and_order.rationale: Including an ineligible invoice is isolated from calculations on eligible rows.

reconciliation_cutoff_and_duplicates.rationale: Applying a post-cutoff payment necessarily changes an invoice balance/status and cross-artifact financial totals.

reconciliation_status_and_decimals.rationale: A wrong status necessarily changes both row semantics and status counts in the summary.

reconciliation_unmatched_reporting.rationale: Dropping unmatched evidence necessarily changes both the report and unmatched summary counts.

reconciliation_summary_and_validation.rationale: Summary corruption and invalid-input atomicity are isolated from valid detail artifacts.
